about: Row-level fixtures for tests/bibliometrics.test.mjs. Frozen from the DEV reciterdb (stale January 2026 iCite/PubMed snapshot, tables rebuilt by the 2026-11-11 nightly), read-only. The v3.11 flags (researchArticleV2, ratedV2, recentV2, authorRoleV2, soleAuthor, provisionalNIH, hasPercentileNIH, pctExact) were computed inline with the plan phase5h-v2-bibliometric.md rules before R2 existed: hasPercentileNIH uses the pre-R1 fallback nih_percentile > 0, recentV2 uses run date 2026-11-11. These are NOT prod acceptance values.
